471| def resolve_owner(explicit: str | None = None) -> str | None:
472|     """Resolve GitHub owner from multiple sources.
473| 
474|     Priority:
475|     1. Explicit value (--owner flag)
476|     2. .project/project.yaml -> project.owner
477|     3. git remote origin URL
478| 
479|     Args:
480|         explicit: Value from CLI flag, if provided.
481| 
482|     Returns:
483|         Resolved owner string, or None if unresolvable.
484|     """
485|     if explicit:
486|         return explicit
487| 
488|     try:
489|         config = load_project_config()
490|         project = config.get("project", {})
491|         owner = project.get("owner")
492|         if owner:
493|             return owner
494|     except (FileNotFoundError, KeyError):
495|         pass
496| 
497|     return get_git_owner()
